subject.title: Tailscale permission error for openclaw user

question: Should the installer automatically grant `openclaw` Tailscale operator authority for the supported Serve workflow, or require an administrator to perform that privilege grant explicitly?
rationale: The reported failure cannot be fixed end-to-end without choosing a persistent Tailscale privilege boundary for an unprivileged service account.

options.title: Grant narrowly for supported Serve
options.body: Approve a scoped, idempotent operator configuration and live Linux validation so the documented Serve workflow works without manual post-install steps.

options.title: Keep explicit administrator setup
options.body: Preserve the current privilege boundary and document the required administrator-run operator command as a deliberate deployment step.

recommendation.title: Grant narrowly for supported Serve
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped, idempotent operator configuration and live Linux validation so the documented Serve workflow works without manual post-install steps.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked candidate implementation already embodies the operator-permission choice and is the most direct routing point for the decision.
